meta.description: A transient bottom-anchored message for confirmations and inline alerts, with optional leading icon, description and trailing action. Auto-dismisses after a short delay.

verdict.title: Keep — documentation gaps only
verdict.text: Rebuilt on node 4915:25141 in the 2026 Working File as Appearance × Theme × Size × three has* booleans, authored as a sparse 22-variant set. The family restructure is complete: Toast and Toast - With Button are merged, the overloaded theme axis is split, every variant value follows §5, layer naming is clean, and the description and trailing action are real Figma Slots composing shared components. All four DS Health traits pass. What remains is documentation — the dismiss and auto-duration contract, the native primitive mapping, and the a11y live-region behaviour.

overview.inContextNote: Toasts float over the app screen — not inline with content. Success toasts confirm completed actions ("Transfer sent"), pending toasts acknowledge background work ("Uploading…"), and error toasts surface failures that don't block the flow. They auto-dismiss after ~3 seconds unless swiped.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Drops into any transient-feedback moment — transfers, uploads, validation errors. Not tied to a specific screen.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Owns its colors and typography, composes a shared Subtext Message for the description and a Button - XSmall for the action, and each Appearance carries its own icon instance from the library. Nothing external required to render.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Appearance and Theme are separate axes, Size uses the standard MD | SM scale, the three has* booleans carry correct verb prefixes and are genuine Figma booleans, and every variant value is Title Cased per §5.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: The trailing action is an addon SLOT holding a Button - XSmall instance — addon being §4's canonical name for this pattern — and the description is a content SLOT carrying a shared Subtext Message. The separate Toast - With Button sibling is retired.

behavior.notes: Toasts appear on a host overlay and auto-dismiss after a duration (~3s short, ~5s long). Host-screen concern — no visual state variant needed.
Standard gesture on both platforms. Not called out in the component spec.
Pending variants already wrap the container in a button element in the Figma code — but no interaction callback is documented.
Pending icon is a static gray circle (icon-placeholder) — should be an animated spinner (ProgressView / CircularProgressIndicator).
Error toasts should announce as assertive; default/pending as polite. Not spec'd.

resolved.headline: Toast and Toast - With Button consolidated.
resolved.body: v2.0: Rebuilt on node 4915:25141 in the 2026 Working File. The two components that modelled one primitive are now a single set — the trailing button is a hasTrailingAction boolean rather than a separate component. Confirmed as a permanent merge by the component owner. (C4 · Family)

resolved.headline: theme axis split into Appearance and Theme.
resolved.body: v2.0: The overloaded axis that mixed status with light/dark is now Appearance (default · destructive · pending) × Theme (dark · light), exactly as recommended. Semantic meaning and visual mode are independent. (C2 · Property)

resolved.headline: Large Label replaced by a real Size axis.
resolved.body: v2.0: The content flag masquerading as a size is now Size = base | sm. Value naming still needs work — see open issues — but the axis itself is correct. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Boolean values normalised.
resolved.body: v2.0: hasLeadingIcon, hasTrailingAction and hasDescription use true/false rather than yes/no strings, and all three carry the correct has verb prefix per §2. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Action slot added.
resolved.body: v2.0: The trailing action is an addon SLOT holding a Button - XSmall instance — and addon is the canonical name §4 gives for exactly this pattern. Consumers can swap the button without detaching. (Slot)

resolved.headline: Description composed from the shared Subtext Message.
resolved.body: v2.0: The description is a content SLOT carrying a shared Subtext Message instance, matching Text Area, Upload File and View Only Field. Copy changes propagate from one source. (Composition)

resolved.headline: Size and Theme values aligned to the standard sets.
resolved.body: v2.1: Size = base | sm → MD | SM, matching §5's XS · SM · MD · LG · XL scale and the values Amount Text Field and View Only Field use. Theme is now Dark | Light in Title Case per §5. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Booleans confirmed as real Figma booleans.
resolved.body: v2.1: hasLeadingIcon, hasTrailingAction and hasDescription now render True/False capitalised, matching every genuine Figma boolean elsewhere in the file. They map directly to Swift Bool and Kotlin Boolean. (C2)

resolved.headline: Layer naming completed.
resolved.body: v2.2: container → ToastRow, the two sibling offset frames → LeadingIcon and TextContent, text-container → TextGroup, and #content → Title. The two anonymous slots also gained names — Text-Slot for the description and Component-Slot for the trailing action. (C1)

resolved.headline: Pending placeholder replaced with a real icon.
resolved.body: v2.2: The icon-placeholder rectangle is gone. LeadingIcon now holds an Information instance from the icon library — chosen by the owner over a spinner, so Pending reads as an informational notice rather than an in-flight progress state. Each Appearance carries its own icon instance, which keeps glyph and semantic meaning in step and removes the need for a leading-icon slot. (C6 · Asset)

resolved.headline: All variant values Title Cased.
resolved.body: v2.3: Appearance=pending → Pending, the last value the casing sweep had missed. Every one of the 22 variant names now conforms to §5 — Appearance = Default | Destructive | Pending, Theme = Dark | Light, Size = MD | SM, and three has* booleans on True | False. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Dismiss and auto-duration contract documented.
resolved.body: v2.4: Documented. Auto-hide — 4 seconds by default; 8 seconds when hasTrailingAction=True, since the user needs time to read the message and reach the action. Appearance=Pending does not auto-hide at all: it represents an in-flight operation and is replaced by a Default or Destructive toast when that operation resolves. Dismissal — a horizontal swipe in either direction dismisses. Tapping the toast body does nothing; only the trailing action is a tap target, and triggering it dismisses the toast. Stacking — one toast at a time; a new message replaces the current one rather than queueing behind it. Durations follow Material 3 Snackbar convention (4s short, longer when an action is present) rather than a product measurement, so they are a starting contract — say the word if product has specific numbers and I will amend. (C5 · Docs)

resolved.headline: Native mapping and a11y live region documented.
resolved.body: v2.4: Documented. iOS — there is no system toast; build a custom view presented through a ViewModifier over the root, anchored to the bottom safe area. Android — Material 3 Snackbar with SnackbarHost covers the Default and Destructive appearances and maps hasTrailingAction onto its action slot, though the Pending appearance and the Theme axis need a custom composable. Accessibility — a transient message that is never focused must be announced, not merely rendered. On iOS post an AccessibilityNotification.Announcement with the message text; on Android set Modifier.semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite }, raised to Assertive for Appearance=Destructive so an error interrupts rather than queues. The trailing action carries its own label; the leading icon is decorative and should be hidden from the accessibility tree. (C4 · A11y · Docs)

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Default for confirmations, Destructive for failures, Pending while something is still in flight.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t use Pending as a warning — it has no Error semantics.

usageGuidelines.doText: Keep the title to one line at 312 px; add hasDescription only for the second fact.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t wrap the title — the Size MD title is a single 14 px line.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use hasTrailingAction for one undo or retry; the button is the XSmall size.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t put two actions in a toast — the set builds one Component-Slot.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use SM inside dense sheets; MD everywhere else.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t combine SM with an action or description — the set does not build them.

changelog.header: Style and Code tabs re-read · node 4915:25141

rows.body: Style tab rebuilt from the 22 live variants. Cards follow Appearance — Default, Destructive, Pending — with Theme, Size and the three booleans as panel controls; colours, the three Title styles and the 38 / 41 / 59 heights read off 4915:25142 and its siblings against the exports; icon glyphs from get_svg. Padding, gap, alignment and colour tokens are not readable with the plugin and stay —. Combinations Figma does not build are composed from the same parts.

Code tab regrouped on the six-property schema. Installation on the Toast family coordinates, Property Mapping one row per property with the two slots, Usage Snippets per Appearance, Guidelines added, Scorecard regraded, Variants Inventory on the 22 live nodes with a summary and collapsed breakdown.

Two title layers are misnamed and the icons carry boolean operations. 4915:25240 names its title #content, 4915:25232 names it LeadingIcon; the three Appearance icons contain shape_full. Filed from the scorecard for the Component Review.

Resolved issues recorded. 13 resolved issues on the Overview tab had no changelog row: Toast and Toast - With Button consolidated; theme axis split into Appearance and Theme; Large Label replaced by a real Size axis; Boolean values normalised; Action slot added; Description composed from the shared Subtext Message; Size and Theme values aligned to the standard sets; Booleans confirmed as real Figma booleans; Layer naming completed; Pending placeholder replaced with a real icon; All variant values Title Cased; Dismiss and auto-duration contract documented; Native mapping and a11y live region documented.
Verdict: Restructure — Consolidate with Toast - With Button, split the overloaded theme axis, rename Large Label to size, and replace the Pending placeholder with a real spinner. Open
C1 — Family duplication — Toast + Toast - With Button model one primitive; merge via optional action slot. Open
C2 — Axis overload — theme mixes appearance + status; Large Label is a size flag; booleans on yes/no. Open
C6 — Pending placeholder — 16/24 gray icon-placeholder circle; adopt a real spinner instance. Open
C5 — Dismiss + duration — No auto-dismiss, swipe, or tap-to-dismiss documented. Open
C4 — Native mapping — Document ToastManager overlay (iOS) + SnackbarHost wrapper (Android). Open
C7 — Code Connect — Blocked on family consolidation + schema cleanup. Open
